  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that sins caused the primary Shechinah to depart because they are opposite the divine will and desire, and that through the Mishkan, Moshe drew down the primary Shechinah and also brought about a new revelation of G-dliness.</sectionSummaryBrief>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the intellectual proof of the desire (taavah) comes from the creation of this lowest world, and that this desire is drawn into the very existence of the world, analogous to how pleasure permeates all faculties and even the bones of a person.

translations.translation: And it can be said that this, that there is a proof in the intellect regarding the matter of the desire
(above reason)
and that the proof is from the coming-into-being of this lowest world, of which there is no lower world beneath it,
is,
because the coming-into-being of this lowest world was from this that He desired
[not in a manner that the matter of desire remained in His Essence and that this, that from the matter of desire this lowest world came into being, is in a manner of separation,
but rather]
that the matter of desire is drawn into the coming-into-being of this lowest world.
[And analogous to the pleasure in a person
(for desire is related to pleasure),
that although pleasure is above all the faculties,
above even will,
nevertheless
(and from this very aspect),
it is drawn into all the faculties of the soul and also into the limbs of the body,
to the extent that the spaciousness of pleasure is drawn and spreads even into the bone of the leg,
"Good news fattens the bone"30.
And therefore the coming-into-being of this lowest world itself
(this that a lower world was created, of which there is no lower beneath it)
proves the matter of desire.
And to add,
that this very thing, that the coming-into-being of this lowest world was in a manner that the matter of desire is drawn into the coming-into-being,
is,
because in order that the intention of a dwelling place in the lower worlds be completed,
that the lower worlds will be a dwelling place for His Essence from the aspect of the lower worlds themselves,
it is necessary that they have some connection to the Essence
(even before they become a dwelling place),
and therefore the coming-into-being of this lowest world from this that He desired was in a manner that in the world itself
(in its coming-into-being)
there will be the matter of desire,
the will of the Essence.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the reason the primary Shechinah was in the lower worlds at the beginning of creation is because the world was brought into being with the desire drawn into it, preparing it to become a dwelling place through human service.

translations.translation: D)

And based on this, we can explain what is said in the maamar, that the reason that the primary Shechinah was in the lower worlds is because the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place for Himself in the lower worlds,
for seemingly,
according to the explanation
(in the maamar)
that this, that He desired a dwelling place in the lower worlds, is that the revelation of G-dliness below
(a dwelling place in the lower worlds)
will be
(not through a drawing down from above, but rather)
through the service of man,
how is the matter of desire etc. for a dwelling place in the lower worlds a reason for this, that at the beginning of creation31
(before the service of man)
the primary Shechinah was in the lower worlds?
And the explanation of this can be said,
that this, that the primary Shechinah was in the lower worlds
(at the beginning of creation)
is that the coming-into-being of this lowest world was in a manner that the matter of desire was drawn into its coming-into-being
(as above),
through which there was made in it the preparation32
that through the service of man it will be a dwelling place for the Essence, also from the aspect of its
(the world's) own being.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that sins caused the primary Shechinah to depart because they are opposite the divine will and desire, and that through the Mishkan, Moshe drew down the primary Shechinah and also brought about a new revelation of G-dliness.

translations.translation: And it can be said,
that this is that through sins the primary Shechinah departed,
for since a sin is the opposite of the will and pleasure from above,
therefore,
through sins the primary Shechinah departed from the earth,
so that there was not in it the matter of desire.
And based on this,
in the drawing down below to the earth through the Mishkan that Moshe made,
there are two matters.
The drawing down of the primary Shechinah below,
"I have come to My garden," to the place that was My primary [dwelling] initially,
through which the world was made fit to be a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He,
as it was at the beginning of creation.
And in addition to this,
through the service of "And they shall make for Me a Sanctuary,"
the world also became a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He,
for there was drawn into it
(into the Mishkan,
and through it into the entire world)
a revelation of G-dliness.
